g.text: Single-run results, separated by task | no failure samples removed
Corrected magnetic frames and unit servo DC gain; no-delay SITL; direct motor/servo commands.
Identical outer-loop gains and limits. One run per condition; no confidence intervals or smoothing.
Status: green = yes; red = no. Air = airborne completion; Acc. = original accuracy criteria.
Airborne requires finished/armed, no cutoff, and true height above 0.5 m.
